_about: KG 38 类全覆盖版（审稿意见 R1-4 补充实验用）。由 kg.json 10 条 + 新增 28 条合并，relation 统一为 symptom，object 为一句式中文症状描述。未改动 kg.json 本身，保证 E5 既有结果可复现。

entries.subject: Apple___Apple_scab
entries.object: 叶片出现橄榄绿色至黑色绒状病斑

entries.subject: Apple___Black_rot
entries.object: 果实与叶片出现黑色凹陷病斑，伴同心轮纹

entries.subject: Apple___Cedar_apple_rust
entries.object: 叶片正面出现橙黄色圆斑，背面生锈色毛状孢子堆

entries.subject: Apple___healthy
entries.object: 苹果叶片形态正常，无病斑与霉层

entries.subject: Blueberry___healthy
entries.object: 蓝莓叶片形态正常，无病斑与霉层

entries.subject: Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew
entries.object: 叶片表面覆白色粉状霉层，幼叶扭曲卷曲

entries.subject: Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy
entries.object: 樱桃叶片形态正常，无病斑与霉层

entries.subject: Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_spot

entries.subject: Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_
entries.object: 叶片散布铁锈色疱状夏孢子堆

entries.subject: Corn_(maize)___healthy

entries.subject: Grape___Black_rot

entries.subject: Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles)

entries.subject: Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spot)

entries.subject: Grape___healthy

entries.subject: Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening)

entries.subject: Peach___Bacterial_spot
